title: An agent-run flow is invisible in the Gallery - no placeholder card, no latents
description: Fabio 2026-09-19: "when I am talking to the agent and the agent runs a flow, and I am in the gallery, I can not see what is happening. I would like, in that case, to have the latents come into the gallery because I am not looking at the flow." ROOT CAUSE, and it is deliberate: `submitFlowGeneration` passes NO `placeholderGroup` (js/services/flowService.js:182-199, MPI-306 - "the flow own result pane is where the run is visible"). The gen IS scope gallery and DOES enter `_myGenIds`, so `preview:frame` reaches MpiGalleryBlock (:1678) - but `_placeholdersForFirst()` (:1636) has no group to mount and `grid.el.updatePreview(tempId, ...)` has no card to paint, so the frame lands nowhere. That premise breaks twice now: an AGENT-dispatched flow has no overlay open at all (js/shell/agentDispatch.js `_submitFlow`), and after MPI-822 a user can queue flow runs and walk back to the gallery. Likely fix: give a flow run its gallery placeholder like every other gen; the flow pane keeps painting by tempId, so both surfaces paint. Detail: brief.md.

attention.reason: Needs a live run only a human can judge: stand in the Gallery, ask the agent to run a flow, and watch a Generating... card appear and its latents paint on it. Verify mode is user-ux and the brief says it outright - nothing in bare Node can see a latent land on a card. Code is complete and its source contracts pass; this is the only open item. Asked twice on 2026-09-20 and not answered before the session closed.
